brief.text: Saka's injury is the big one this morning: Arteta has spoken about it publicly, and one camp wants a formation change while Gyökeres's old mentor is pushing a riskier tweak, so expect some tinkering on the right this weekend. Don't be fooled by the rumour tags on Bruno Guimarães, because he's already an Arsenal player, and his praise for Declan Rice and his story of a tearful Newcastle exit are about a midfield bedding in, not a transfer saga. The real transfer news is thin: contact with the reps of a 20-year-old Bundesliga forward is the only lead that counts as developing, while the Portuguese striker tearing up Serie A and Nicolò Tresoldi, who already comes with a January snag, are firmly rumour territory, and nothing is anywhere near "here we go." The results keep coming but the "unwatchable" jibes won't go away, and a weekend without Saka isn't the time to expect fireworks.
